trailhead.label: Top station of the Texelbahn above Partschins, the board’s start

cautions: About 1,120 m of descent: steep in places and hard on knees and paws, take it slowly.
A short stretch of tarred farm road after the Hochforch farm: lead on for passing cars.
Meadows and pastures beside the path are farmed: keep to the path.
Carry water even though water points are listed.
Follow local signs, lead rules and temporary closures.

emergency.note: Call the European emergency number when urgent help is required. Connectivity is not guaranteed.

textIt.Meraner Höhenweg west and the Sonnenberg: Meraner Höhenweg ovest e i masi del Sonnenberg, Partschins
textIt.Top station of the Texelbahn above Parts: Stazione a monte della Texelbahn sopra Partschins, punto di partenza della scheda ufficiale
textIt.About 1,120 m of descent: steep in place: Circa 1.120 m di discesa: ripida in alcuni punti e pesante per ginocchia e zampe, vai piano.
textIt.A short stretch of tarred farm road afte: Un breve tratto di strada agricola asfaltata dopo il maso Hochforch: guinzaglio per le auto di passaggio.
textIt.Meadows and pastures beside the path are: I prati e i pascoli accanto al sentiero sono coltivati: resta sul sentiero.
